title: Reports runtime directory
responsibility: Finds the reports package runtime root for supporting tools and assets.

outputs.name: reportRuntimeRoot
outputs.description: A string: the HARNESS_REPORTS_RUNTIME_ROOT value whenever that variable is set (an empty string counts as set and is returned unchanged); otherwise the packages/reports directory three parent steps above the defining module's directory, as an absolute path. The override is returned as-is without path.resolve(), normalization or an existence check, and the fallback has no trailing slash because path.resolve() strips it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown only when HARNESS_REPORTS_RUNTIME_ROOT is not set and either new URL cannot resolve '../../..' against import.meta.url or fileURLToPath rejects the result (for example when the module is loaded from an http: or data: URL). The function has no try/catch, so the TypeError reaches the caller unchanged.
